language_with_special_member.ascii: for s in L[alnum] ∪ {"n/a"}|missing, len(f(s)) <= len(s)

language_encoding_boundary.ascii: for s in L[latin-1]|missing, f(s) = s

language_section_inverse.unicode: let u = mathema_language.lexicon.unescape_angle, ∀ s ∈ L[unicode]|missing, u(f(s)) = s
language_section_inverse.ascii: let u = mathema_language.lexicon.unescape_angle, for s in L[unicode]|missing, u(f(s)) = s
